shortDescription: Manage application filters on PAN-OS devices.

options.name: api_key
options.description: B(Deprecated) Use I(provider) to specify PAN-OS connectivity instead. HORIZONTALLINE The API key to use instead of generating it using I(username) / I(password).

options.name: category
options.description: Application category

options.name: device_group
options.description: (Panorama only) The device group the operation should target.

options.name: evasive
options.description: If the applications are evasive

options.name: excessive_bandwidth_use
options.description: If the applications use excessive bandwidth

options.name: gathered_filter
options.description: When I(state=gathered). An advanced filtering option to filter results returned from PAN-OS. Refer to the guide discussing I(gathered_filter) for more information.

options.name: has_known_vulnerabilities
options.description: If the applications have known vulnerabilities

options.name: ip_address

options.name: is_saas

options.name: name

options.name: password

options.name: pervasive
options.description: If the applications are used pervasively

options.name: port

options.name: state

options.description: Application subcategory

options.description: Application technology

options.name: used_by_malware
options.description: If the applications are used by malware
